observations: Red-brown brick, three upper rows of three windows, flat parapet (no projecting bracket cornice). Mustard/cream checkerboard spandrel panels below each upper window, dark flat lintels, brown/red central escape.

Nail salon at left/center and AT&T at right have separate black/gold and black/white fascia; narrow residential entry separates shops.
